company_name: Shanghai Ebara Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential equipment for semiconductor fabrication and assembly processes.
summary: Shanghai Ebara Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. specializes in providing critical equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, including chemical mechanical polishing systems, dry vacuum pumps, wafer plating systems, and abatement systems. These products are vital for the production and assembly of advanced semiconductor devices, supporting both fabrication and environmental management needs.

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai, the company operates as a subsidiary of Ebara Manufacturing Co., Ltd. of Japan.
